verdicts.reason: Both break up the original's design: the two white bars sit in the far top and bottom corners instead of crossing the dark panel, and a small panel floats mid-canvas with a lot of dead image above and below it. A's headline is undersized for a 432×768 story but is still the larger and more readable of the two, and its wider panel has more even padding. B's headline is even smaller and is crammed into the panel with almost no vertical breathing room, which makes the main message weaker still.
